hints.title: Distributive Property of Bitwise Operations
hints.text: The bitwise and operation distributes over bitwise exclusive-or in the same way multiplication distributes over addition.

hints.title: Factoring Across Arrays
hints.text: The full pairwise expression factors directly into the exclusive-or sum of the first array bitwise and the exclusive-or sum of the second array.

hints.title: Single Pass Reductions
hints.text: Compute the cumulative exclusive-or of each array independently, then return their bitwise and.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from functools import reduce
from operator import xor

class Solution:
    def getXORSum(self, arr1: list[int], arr2: list[int]) -> int:
        xor1 = reduce(xor, arr1)
        xor2 = reduce(xor, arr2)
        return xor1 & xor2
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n * m pairs explicitly takes O(n * m) time, timing out for 10^5 elements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distributive factoring reduces the calculation to two independent O(n) and O(m) linear passes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies algebraic distributive identity (A ^ B) & (C ^ D) = (A & C) ^ (A & D) ^ ...
